This is the most brilliant political ad I've ever seen. Democrats are telling Republicans why the Republican candidate is bad and the Libertarian candidate, whom most Republicans have never even heard of, is worse.

The ad, paid for by the Ohio Democratic Party and authorized by Friends of Sherrod Brown, describes the Republican incumbent as voting for reckless government spending that increased the national debt, which is true and should upset conservative Republicans.

But it also accuses the Libertarian candidate of being an outsider who doesn't belong in D.C. because he wants to abolish the IRS and replace it with a flat tax, balance the federal budget, cut wasteful government spending, defend the Constitution, and support gun rights no matter what.

In other words, the Libertarian actually stands for what conservative Republicans support. The purpose of the ad is not to win votes for the Democrats, but to persuade Republicans to either vote Libertarian or not vote at all. I think it will work.
